title: VPG Engine — Arena stages
description: The stages an arena can be built on, and which floor, barricade and outer pieces fit each one. An arena names a stage id; the editor offers only the pieces listed here, because the sets are modelled to fit together and mixing them leaves gaps.

schema_version.description: Optional stages schema version. Current version is 1.

id.description: Stage identifier, as an arena file's `stage` field names it.

position.description: Placement for a stage GLB that is not authored in arena space: scene units, applied to the GLB root after loading. Same convention as an arena's arenaParts position.

rotation.description: Euler radians [x, y, z] for a stage GLB that is not authored in arena space. Same convention as an arena's arenaParts rotation.

scale.description: Uniform scale for a stage GLB authored at a different size, applied to the GLB root about its own origin, before rotation and position.

barricadeFloors.description: The floor each barricade is built to stand on, keyed by barricade path. Choosing a barricade in the editor re-picks its floor, and an arena that names a barricade but no floor gets this one instead of the stage default. Both paths should also appear in this stage's lists.

piece_list.description: Pieces that fit this stage. The first is the default an arena gets when it selects the stage.
